LanguageData.MT_SettingsLanguageHint: Choose a language for this mod's interface. The default follows the game language. Language choices and translations can be extended through XML files; select the language again to reload its text.
LanguageData.MT_ManageDesc: Install or remove parts and upgrade the turret's parts and base.
LanguageData.MT_AttackDesc: Set the main weapon's target. Auxiliary weapons acquire their own targets.
LanguageData.MT_HoldFireDesc: Stop the main and auxiliary weapons from firing.
LanguageData.MT_ClearTargetDesc: Allow the main weapon to acquire targets automatically.
LanguageData.MT_AutoReloadDesc: Queue a construction job to fill the magazine to 20 shells when 6 or fewer remain.
LanguageData.MT_TurretReconnectPowerDesc: Look for a nearby wired power connection. If none is available, find a wireless coil on the same floor whose range reaches this turret.
LanguageData.MT_InspectNoHead: No main head installed. Open assembly management to install one.

LanguageData.MT_AssemblyNoHead: Craft a main head at the assembly bench, then install it here. Available module slots depend on the main head.
LanguageData.MT_AssemblyRules: Part install/remove work: 100 · Removal failure: 1% per part · Part tiers remain after removal.
LanguageData.MT_ReloadReject: The magazine is full or a reload job is already queued.
LanguageData.MT_ReloadTip: Request delivery of {0} {1}. Reload work is 0. Each delivered shell is loaded immediately, starting with the first round; a full magazine is not required.
LanguageData.MT_NeedCraftedPart: A crafted physical part is required.
LanguageData.MT_RemoveHeadFirst: Remove the attached modules before removing the main head.
LanguageData.MT_SlotHasOrder: Complete or cancel this slot's queued work first.
LanguageData.MT_RemoveTip: Work: 100. On completion, this part has a 1% chance to become steel slag.
LanguageData.MT_PartUpgradeReject: Required research is incomplete, or this slot has another job queued.
LanguageData.MT_NoParts: No suitable part can currently be selected on this map. Craft one at the assembly bench and ensure it is not forbidden or reserved.
